purpose: Submission is permitted when item details, quantity, estimated cost and justification are all present
preconditions: Employee logged in; draft indent with item details, quantity, estimated cost and justification filled
expected_result: Submission succeeds; indent gets a unique ID and timestamp and proceeds to review

purpose: Block submission when item details are missing and identify the missing field
preconditions: Draft indent with quantity, estimated cost and justification but no item details
expected_result: Submission blocked; the response names item details as missing; no indent is submitted

purpose: Block submission when quantity is missing
preconditions: Draft indent lacking quantity, other required fields filled
expected_result: Submission blocked; quantity identified as missing

purpose: Block submission when estimated cost is missing
preconditions: Draft indent lacking estimated cost, other required fields filled
expected_result: Submission blocked; estimated cost identified as missing

purpose: Block submission when justification is missing
preconditions: Draft indent lacking justification, other required fields filled
expected_result: Submission blocked; justification identified as missing

purpose: Completeness validation also applies on resubmission after modification
preconditions: Existing indent in a modifiable state
action_or_input: Modify the indent by clearing a required field and resubmit
expected_result: Resubmission blocked and the missing information identified

purpose: Route to internal issue when sufficient allocable stock exists
preconditions: Submitted indent; departmental or central stock allocable quantity >= requested quantity
action_or_input: Run stock availability check for fulfilment
expected_result: Indent routed to internal issue; not routed to external procurement

purpose: Route to external procurement when stock is insufficient
preconditions: Submitted indent; combined departmental and central allocable stock < requested quantity
action_or_input: Run stock availability check for fulfilment
expected_result: Indent routed toward external procurement

purpose: Central stock is checked in addition to departmental stock before external procurement
preconditions: Departmental stock is 0; central stock is sufficient
expected_result: Indent routed to internal issue using central stock, not external procurement

purpose: External procurement cannot be initiated without a prior stock check
preconditions: Submitted indent with no stock check recorded
action_or_input: Attempt to start external procurement for the indent
expected_result: Stock check is performed first; external procurement proceeds only if stock is insufficient

purpose: Indent routes to the authority required by configured threshold for lower cost
preconditions: Approval hierarchy and cost thresholds configured; indent estimated cost in the lowest configured band
expected_result: Routed to the approver configured for that band only

purpose: Indent above a configured threshold routes to the higher authority in hierarchy
preconditions: Same configuration; indent estimated cost in a higher configured band
expected_result: Routed to the higher authority required by configuration

purpose: Routing follows the configured hierarchy rather than fixed values
preconditions: Administrator changes threshold configuration
action_or_input: Submit indent whose cost falls in the band changed by the configuration
expected_result: Routing follows the updated configuration

purpose: Higher-priority indent may follow a more direct path where configured policy permits
preconditions: Policy permits direct path for high priority; high-priority indent submitted
expected_result: Indent routed via the configured more direct approval path

purpose: Rejection is blocked without justification
preconditions: Indent pending with an approver
action_or_input: Approver chooses Reject with empty justification
expected_result: Rejection blocked; justification required; indent state unchanged

purpose: Rejection with justification sets rejected state, notifies requestor and logs decision
preconditions: Indent pending with an approver
expected_result: Indent state is Rejected; requestor notified including outcome; audit log entry with justification recorded

purpose: Notifications are sent and retained for submission and approval events
preconditions: Notification configuration active
action_or_input: Submit an indent and then approve it
expected_result: Applicable notifications generated for both events and stored in communication history

purpose: Alerts are generated and retained for dispatch and receipt events
preconditions: Internal issue or PO delivery in progress
expected_result: Dispatch and receipt notifications generated and retained in communication history

purpose: Alerts are generated and retained for invoice and payment status events
preconditions: Invoice received for a PO
action_or_input: Record invoice status change and payment status change
expected_result: Notifications generated for both and retained in communication history

purpose: Communication history remains retrievable after events
preconditions: Several lifecycle notifications previously sent
action_or_input: Retrieve communication history for the indent
expected_result: All prior notifications are listed and retained

purpose: Modification allowed in a permissible state, versioned and revalidated
preconditions: Policy configured so state S permits modification; indent in S
expected_result: Modification allowed; new version saved; indent re-enters applicable review path after revalidation

purpose: Modification blocked in a non-permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not permitted for modification
expected_result: Action blocked; indent unchanged

purpose: Withdrawal allowed in a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state permitting withdrawal
expected_result: Indent withdrawn successfully

purpose: Withdrawal blocked in a non-permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not permitting withdrawal
expected_result: Action blocked; state unchanged

purpose: Cancellation allowed in a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state permitting cancellation
expected_result: Indent cancelled successfully

purpose: Cancellation blocked in a non-permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not permitting cancellation
expected_result: Action blocked; state unchanged

purpose: Direct procurement selected when configured value threshold requires direct
preconditions: Tender threshold configured; indent routed to external procurement with value on the direct side of the threshold
expected_result: Direct procurement is selected

purpose: Tender procurement selected when configured value threshold requires tender
preconditions: Same configuration; value on the tender side of the threshold
expected_result: Tender procurement workflow is selected

purpose: Confirmed receipt without discrepancy allows final stock posting
preconditions: Goods delivered; receipt confirmed; no discrepancy
action_or_input: Finalize stock posting and payment release evaluation
expected_result: Final posting allowed and payment may proceed (subject to other rules)

purpose: Final stock posting and payment blocked without delivery confirmation
preconditions: Goods delivered but receipt not confirmed
action_or_input: Attempt final stock posting and payment release
expected_result: Both blocked until delivery confirmation

purpose: Discrepancy opens handling and blocks final posting and payment until resolved
preconditions: Goods delivered with a reported discrepancy
action_or_input: Report discrepancy, then attempt final posting and payment
expected_result: Discrepancy handling opened; final posting and payment blocked; after resolution they are allowed

purpose: High-value indent requiring final review is recommended by PS Admin to Director/Registrar
preconditions: Policy requires Director/Registrar final review; indent at PS Admin
expected_result: Indent routed to Director/Registrar as recommendation

purpose: Approved procurement returns to PS Admin for PO/tender execution
preconditions: Indent awaiting Director/Registrar decision
expected_result: Indent routed back to PS Admin for purchase order/tender execution

purpose: Rejection by Director/Registrar closes the indent as rejected with justification
preconditions: Indent awaiting Director/Registrar decision
expected_result: Indent closed as Rejected; justification recorded

purpose: PO issuance permitted for fully verified vendor
preconditions: Vendor with verified GST, bank details and compliance documents; approved indent
expected_result: PO issued

purpose: PO issuance blocked for unverified vendor
preconditions: Vendor with missing/unverified master data
expected_result: PO issuance blocked

purpose: Payment blocked for unverified vendor
preconditions: Vendor unverified; invoice otherwise eligible
expected_result: Payment blocked

purpose: Continuation permitted once verification is completed
preconditions: Vendor initially unverified, then GST, bank and compliance documents verified
expected_result: Action permitted

purpose: Allocated stock is reserved and excluded from available stock
preconditions: Stock quantity 10 available; indent allocation of 4
action_or_input: Allocate stock to indent and query availability
expected_result: 4 reserved; allocable availability is 6

purpose: Reserved stock cannot be committed to another request
preconditions: Stock 10, 10 reserved for indent A
expected_result: Reserved stock not counted as available; second indent not allocated from it

purpose: Stock for approved transfer remains reserved until dispatch/receipt lifecycle releases/consumes it
preconditions: Approved transfer with reserved stock, not yet received
expected_result: Reservation remains in force until lifecycle completes

purpose: Reminder issued when a pending approval reaches configured SLA
preconditions: SLA rule configured; approval pending past SLA
action_or_input: SLA monitor evaluates the pending action
expected_result: Reminder sent; event retained in audit trail

purpose: Escalation notification issued when escalation condition is reached
preconditions: Escalation rule configured; pending action reaches escalation condition
expected_result: Escalation notification sent; event audited

purpose: Higher-criticality indents are prioritized in approval queue per configured policy
preconditions: Department Admin recorded criticality on two indents; policy prioritizes higher criticality
expected_result: Higher-criticality indent prioritized ahead per policy

purpose: No reminder or escalation before SLA condition is reached
preconditions: Pending action within SLA
expected_result: No reminder or escalation issued

purpose: Likely duplicate flagged for Department Admin review without auto-merge or cancel
preconditions: Existing indent; duplicate-detection criteria configured; new indent matching criteria
expected_result: Indent flagged for Department Admin review; not merged or auto-cancelled; procurement does not continue until review

purpose: Duplicate detection also runs on modified indent submission
preconditions: Existing indent A; indent B modified to match A under configured criteria
expected_result: Indent B flagged for review

purpose: Non-matching indent is not flagged
preconditions: No existing indent matches configured criteria
expected_result: Not flagged as duplicate

purpose: Payment marked eligible when PO, accepted GRN, invoice verification, delivery confirmation and vendor verification are all satisfied
preconditions: All conditions satisfied
expected_result: Payment marked eligible

purpose: Payment held when required PO does not exist
preconditions: Invoice with no PO; other conditions met
expected_result: Payment on hold with recorded reason

purpose: Payment held when GRN/receipt is not accepted
preconditions: GRN not accepted; other conditions met
expected_result: Payment on hold with recorded reason

purpose: Payment held when invoice verification incomplete
preconditions: Invoice verification incomplete; other conditions met
expected_result: Payment on hold with recorded reason

purpose: Payment held when delivery confirmation not satisfied
preconditions: Delivery not confirmed; other conditions met
expected_result: Payment on hold with recorded reason

purpose: Payment held when vendor verification invalid
preconditions: Vendor unverified; other conditions met
expected_result: Payment on hold with recorded reason

purpose: Invoice not held when PO, GRN and invoice match
preconditions: PO, GRN and invoice consistent
expected_result: No mismatch hold placed

purpose: Mismatch places invoice on hold with reason and notifications; payment blocked
preconditions: Invoice differs from PO/GRN
action_or_input: Perform three-way match then attempt payment release
expected_result: Invoice/payment on hold; reason recorded; responsible parties notified; payment not released until mismatch resolved

purpose: Resolved return/replacement/warranty case applies inventory and accounting adjustments and retains history
preconditions: Discrepancy/return case exists
expected_result: Required inventory and accounting adjustments applied per policy; resolution history retained

purpose: No adjustments applied before resolution is approved/recorded
preconditions: Open return case not yet resolved
expected_result: No resolution adjustments applied

purpose: Authorized role can perform permitted function
preconditions: Department Admin user logged in
action_or_input: Access a function permitted to Department Admin
expected_result: Access permitted

purpose: Unauthorized role is denied function/information
preconditions: Employee user logged in
action_or_input: Attempt to access Accounts-only payment release function
expected_result: Access denied; no action performed

purpose: Material action is logged with actor, action, target, resulting state and timestamp
preconditions: Indent exists
expected_result: Audit record contains actor, action, target, resulting state and timestamp

purpose: Each indent modification retained as distinct version
preconditions: Indent in modifiable state
expected_result: Original and two new versions retained and retrievable; audit entries created

purpose: Vendor master change retains version history
preconditions: Existing vendor master record
expected_result: New version and audit entry created; prior values retained

purpose: Partial receipt recorded and remaining open balance retained
preconditions: PO for 100 units; delivery of 60
expected_result: Partial GRN recorded; 40 remain open

purpose: Partial payment limited to quantities/amounts supported by accepted receipt and invoice verification
preconditions: Partial payment rule configured; 60 units accepted and invoice verified for 60
expected_result: Payable portion determined per policy for accepted/verified portion; remaining balance retained

purpose: Payment beyond accepted receipt/verified invoice is not released
preconditions: 60 units accepted; attempt to pay for 100
expected_result: Payment beyond supported portion blocked

purpose: Bid evaluation against criteria and committee approval recorded before procurement proceeds
preconditions: Tender received bids; evaluation criteria defined
action_or_input: Evaluate bids and record committee selection
expected_result: Evaluation and committee decision recorded and traceable; procurement proceeds

purpose: Selected procurement cannot proceed without recorded committee approval
preconditions: Bids evaluated; no committee decision recorded
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with selected bid/PO
expected_result: Proceeding blocked until committee decision recorded

purpose: Authorized user can generate report and the event is logged
preconditions: User authorized for report
action_or_input: Request report with filter and export
expected_result: Report generated and export available; generation event logged

purpose: Unauthorized user denied reports/dashboards/exports
preconditions: User not authorized for the report
expected_result: Access denied

purpose: Scheduled generation validates schedule/report authorization and logs event
preconditions: Configured report schedule becomes due; authorization valid
expected_result: Report generated and generation event logged

purpose: Vendor master creation persists version/change record and audit entry
preconditions: PS Admin authorized
expected_result: Version record and audit entry persisted

purpose: Vendor master change keeps prior values traceable
preconditions: Existing vendor record with version 1
expected_result: New version created; version 1 values still retrievable; audit entry recorded

purpose: Only accepted quantities posted to stock when confirmation conditions satisfied
preconditions: Receipt of 100 units, 90 accepted, 10 rejected; confirmed
expected_result: 90 units posted; 10 not posted

purpose: Unresolved-discrepancy quantities not finally posted and kept unresolved
preconditions: Receipt with discrepant quantity unresolved
expected_result: Discrepant quantity not posted; remains unresolved

purpose: Partial receipt posts only the accepted received portion
preconditions: PO 100 units; 60 received and accepted
expected_result: 60 units posted; remainder not posted

purpose: Destination confirmation completes transfer, updates source and destination ledgers and logs completion
preconditions: Approved, dispatched inter-departmental transfer
expected_result: Transfer completed; source ledger decreased and destination ledger increased; completion logged

purpose: Ledgers not updated before destination confirms receipt
preconditions: Transfer dispatched, not confirmed
expected_result: Ledgers not yet updated; transfer not complete

purpose: Configured business rule is applied before a governed action proceeds
preconditions: Configured policy rule that the action violates
action_or_input: Attempt governed action (e.g., payment/procurement action violating the rule)
expected_result: Action blocked by configured rule

purpose: Compliant governed action proceeds after rule is applied
preconditions: Configured policy rule satisfied
expected_result: Action allowed to proceed
